hook: Know what's inside an app before you run it.
hookText: Analyze Anything: proof for every finding

beats.say: Analyze Anything is an open-source Rust CLI and macOS app. Give it an IPA, APK, DMG, pkg, Windows installer, or any file.
It only reads, never runs. It unpacks containers layer by layer, relates files to one another, and works offline: same input, same report.
Every finding cites its evidence: which file, where in it, and what bytes were read. On Notepad plus plus, it verified the installer's signature.
